title: lint-cdc result.json contract
description: Complete contract for <module>/Design/lint-cdc/result.json. stage_specific.violations[] carries the gated rows, severity=error and severity=warning alike (one record per id+rule+severity+reason), so it is required but empty on status=pass, and populated on a rule-based fail; it is not required on an infra/license early-fail, where no report was parsed at all. On status=fail, stage_specific.fail_reason is required (if/then below): the failure narrative, read by the stage this round routes to and parsed by nothing.

fix_owner.description: On status=fail: the rule that must act, named by this stage from what it read in the raw tool output. Deliberately NOT an enum — the derived input closure in rules.py is the only authority on which names are legal, and decide checks it there. Naming this stage itself (its in-stage remedy is exhausted) or naming nobody both mean a human decides.
